newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Qantas aims to buy Jetset stake - paper.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Qantas aims to buy Jetset stake - paper.

text.p: Qantas Airways Ltd is planning to buy Air New Zealand Ltd's 50 percent stake in Australian-based travel agency, Jetset, for between A$15 million and A$50 million, The Australian Financial Review newspaper reported on Monday.

"The deal would involve Isi Leibler, the chairman and managing director of Jetset, exercising an option to acquire Air New Zealand's 11-year-old stake in the group and then onselling it to Qantas," the Financial Review said.
"According to insiders, Qantas would wind up with 50 percent of the travel distribution and technology conglomerate for anything from A$15 million to A$50 million," the Financial Review said.
Leibler would retain his half share in Jetset and management control, but would have an exit clause included allowing either partner the first option to buy the other out, the newspaper said.

"Qantas' move to secure part of Jetset, underpinning an extensive commercial deal struck last year would give the arirline a powerful stake in the wholesale and retail industry to counter the expanding Traveland busines of its rival Anset," it said.

"It would also act as a block to Ansett's 50 percent owner, Air New Zealand, eventually consolidating the Jetset operation with that of Traveland to tie up a considerable share of the Australasian distribution market."
Qantas said last year it would buy Jetset's Tour East operations.
